description_en: An inscription dated 1713 CE at the northern wall in the sanctum informs readers of donations made to the temple and the annual worships observed (VajrācāryaVS 2056, 391). It can thus be assumed that the temple dates from 1713 CE or possibly earlier. Sūryavināyaka Mandira is attached to the eastern wall of the Bāhālukhā Maṭha with almost half of it's floor recessed into themaṭha. The temple rests on a raised plinth and is one of the few east-facing Gaṇeśa temples in Patan. The front portion features timber posts on the corners with capitals (metha)supporting the cross beams indicating that the front portion of the temple was originally open. The spaces between columns were later filled in with masonry walls and enclosed with a decorative door in the center. There is a small blind window above the main entry. At a later date, the temple was extended by about 70 cm towards the north, employing regular brick. The temple's roof features hanging eaves (yangāḥpākhā), is supported by 8 plain struts, covered with traditional clay tiles (jhĩgaṭī), and is topped with a small pinnacle. Thetoraṇaabove the entrance has been stolen.Inside the sanctum is a small, temple-like structure, in the niche of which is an aniconic stone image revered as Gaṇeśa.Most of the ritual worship at the temple is performed by a Śreṣṭha family residing in the Bāhālukhā area to the east of the temple. Local people believe that their predecessors built the temple.
description_ne: यो बाहालुखा टोलमा रहेको एकछाने सानो मन्दिर एउटा मठको पूर्वी गाह्रोसँग टाँसिएर रहेको छ । पाटनमा रहेका केही मात्र पूर्व फर्किएका गणेश मन्दिरहरूमध्ये यो एक हो ।  यस मन्दिरका विशेष पूजाहरू यसै मन्दिरको अगाडि यसै टोलमा बस्ने एउटा श्रेष्ठ परिवारले  गर्ने गर्दछन् र उनीहरूकै पूर्वजले यो मन्दिर स्थापना गरेको हुन सक्छ । मन्दिरका धेरै भागहरू भत्किएका छन् र २०७३ सालको भूकम्पको असरले मन्दिर अलिकति ढल्केको छ । स्थानीय वासिन्दाले दिएको जानकारी अनुसार मन्दिरको ढोकाको तोरण केही वर्ष अघि चोरी भयो ।मन्दिरको छाना टायलले छाइएको छ । छानामाथि सानो ढुङ्गाको गजुर छ । मन्दिरको प्रवेशद्वार काठले बनेको छ र त्यसमा कलात्मक बुट्टाहरू कुँदिएका छन् । ठोकामाथिको तोरण पहिल्यै चोरी भैसक्यो । मन्दिरको गर्भगृहमा मन्दिराकार सानो संरचना छ जसको प्रतिमास्थानमा गणेशको नकुँदिएको शिलाको प्रतिमा छ । प्रतिमास्थानभन्दा उत्तरपट्टि भित्तामा एउटा शिलालेख टाँसिएको छ जसमा मन्दिरको वार्षिक पूजाको लागि गरिएको दानको बारेमा जानकारी पाइन्छ । शिलालेखमा लेखिएका सबै जसो अक्षरहरू मेटिइसकेका छन् । वज्राचार्य (विसं २०५६, ३९१) ले यो शिलालेख पढिसकेका छन् ।
brick_type: dāci apā (conical veneer brick), mā apā (regular fired brick)
monument_assessment: Heavily damaged (collapsed, demolished, major cracks and structural damages)
references: Sources and references Inscription identification number LAL0251_I_001 Sources In 2018, the stone stele inscription was documented inside the sanctum, partially covered by debris. Vajrācārya (VS 2056, 391) Details When visiting the temple in November 2024, the inscription could not be located. It might have disappeared or it might have been buried under a pile of bricks and garbage stored in the sanctum.

historical_events.event_description: 12moharas were donated by Rameśvara Bāro, Kausiṁha Bāro and other Bāros for the annual worship of the temple.
